shortDescription: Configures the Db2 Mirror on the target node.

options.name: become_user
options.description: The name of the user profile that the IBM i task will run under. Use this option to set a user with desired privileges to run the task.

options.name: become_user_password
options.description: Use this option to set the password of the user specified in C(become_user).

options.name: ip_address
options.description: The setup copy system IP address.

options.name: rdma_subnet_mask
options.description: Sets the subnet mask if the RDMA links subnet is different than the system IP address. If set to C(*SAME), will retrieve the subnet mask from the system IP address.
